}}'''Adria''' is a contortionist in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Adria}}

==Appearance==
Adria is a slim woman. Her lips, according to [[Olver]], make him want to kiss her.{{ref/book|9|15}}

==Activities==
Adria is one of several women who have taken an interest in Olver. When he leaves the show with [[Matrim Cauthon]], Olver spends time with Adria, [[Gillin]], [[Jameine]], [[Merici]] and [[Neilyn]].{{ref/book|9|15}} Later, Adria and [[Rumann]], a sword juggler, begin courting.{{ref/book|10|2}}
